commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+6' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul.
90+4' 2 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Sheraldo Becker plays it into the box, and Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) gets on the end of the cross to put it low into the middle of the net. 2:1.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
87' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the bottom left corner is saved by Alex Remiro.
86' Substitution. Raul Garcia (Osasuna) in, Ante Budimir out.
86' Here is a change. Ruben Garcia is going off and Vicente Moreno gives the last tactical orders to Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna).
86' The referee blows his whistle as Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) was too aggressive in his challenge.
85' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the bottom right corner is thwarted by Sergio Herrera.
81' A cross from a corner kick by Real Sociedad is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
80' 39:61 – this is the current ball possession ratio. The number of shots on goal at present is 3:1.
79' Corner kick. Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is ready to send the ball into the box.
78' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Igor Zubeldia as he is replaced by Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad).
78' Imanol Alguacil prepares a substitution. Mikel Oyarzabal is replaced by Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad).
78' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Takefusa Kubo walks off the pitch to be replaced by Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad).
78' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The linesman makes the right call and Real Sociedad will have a corner.
76' The attendance is 21678.
74' 2 - 0 Goal! Ruben Garcia swings the ball deep into the box and finds Ante Budimir (Osasuna) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the top left corner. 2:0.
73' A corner kick by Osasuna is thwarted by the well prepared Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad).

71' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
71' Vicente Moreno decides to make a substitution. Lucas Torro will be replaced by Iker Munoz (Osasuna).
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Moi Gomez (Osasuna) is coming onto the pitch as Juan Cruz cannot continue after picking up an injury.
70' Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.

69' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
68' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
66' Imanol Alguacil has decided to make a change. Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) replaces Ander Barrenetxea.
66' Substitution. Jon Ander Olasagasti leaves the pitch and is replaced by Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad).
66' Real Sociedad work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

65' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The referee blows his whistle, Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
63' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
63' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY, play can continue.
62' Referee Miguel Ortiz makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
60' Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. PENALTY! One of the players from Osasuna is about to take a penalty kick.
59' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
59' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul. Osasuna are awarded a free kick.
57' Here comes a substitution. Abel Bretones (Osasuna) is brought on as a substitute for Kike Barja.
56' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
54' Osasuna take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

51' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) connects with a cross on the edge of the box, controls the ball and pulls the trigger. Sergio Herrera makes a beautiful save to deny his effort which would have ended inside the right post.
48' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
46' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Referee Miguel Ortiz has finally had enough of Vicente Moreno and brandishes a yellow card at him!
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.

45' Wonderful pass from Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) for Ander Barrenetxea, but they can't profit from it as Sergio Herrera comes off his line to collect. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
44' Real Sociedad failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
39' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
39' Miguel Ortiz has a clear sight and sees a foul from Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad). Osasuna have been awarded a free kick.

37' Ooh that was close! Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
34' 1 - 0 Goal! Aimar Oroz provides Ante Budimir (Osasuna) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort inside the left post. 1:0.
31' The game is interrupted. Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
29' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the right of the target.
29' Miguel Ortiz interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Kike Barja (Osasuna).

28' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball towards the roof of the net. Alex Remiro shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.

26' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
26' Real Sociedad have a corner.
16' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

16' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. It's a free kick to Real Sociedad, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
15' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
14' Referee Miguel Ortiz makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
13' One of the Osasuna players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
4' Corner kick. Osasuna will have an opportunity.
4' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Osasuna get a corner.
